title: MASS_ASSIGNMENT: request body sends privilege/status fields the UI never sends (status, isAdmin, verified, role, priceProtection.status)
unsupported_reason: This is a field-acceptance / mass-assignment claim (whether the server persists unexpected privileged fields such as status, isAdmin, verified, role from the request body) rather than a numeric amount comparison. sum_lte cannot express 'field X was ignored/rejected'; this requires manual/structural review of the before vs after order object for each injected key, which is outside the supported amount_bound predicate.
